provider: Ethereum blobs (EIP-4844) as a storage layer

free_tier.stated: No free tier. Live cost at time of check: $0.012 per MB as blobs (vs $11.01/MB as calldata). 128 KB per blob package, separate blob fee market.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: ~18-day retention; per-block blob count cap; cost floats with the blob fee market.

egress.terms: Free to read while data exists, but data is pruned by consensus nodes after ~18 days. Retrieval after that depends on third-party archival indexers (Blobscan etc.), not on Ethereum.

tooling: blobkit.org (TypeScript SDK for blob transactions), Blobscan API, standard Ethereum JSON-RPC.
chaining: Multiply cost, not capacity: 10 TiB/month = 10,485,760 MB x $0.012 = ~$125,800/month, and the data expires in 18 days regardless of payment.
limits_note: ~18-day retention; per-block blob count cap; cost floats with the blob fee market.
